title: amylotheca cordilimba
intro: Amylotheca cordilimba, commonly known as the mountain hibiscus, is a type of flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Australia and New Guinea. The health benefits of Amylotheca cordilimba include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antispasmodic and its potential to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Amylotheca cordilimba include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
